For HYROX training and racing under $150, I'd prioritize a watch with accurate running GPS, reliable heart-rate tracking, interval timers, and enough battery for a full race.

HYROX combines 8 × 1 km runs with 8 workout stations, so a good watch needs to handle both running and functional fitness.

My top pick is the COROS PACE 3 if you can find it on sale for $150 or less. Otherwise, Garmin's entry-level Forerunner models and the Amazfit Active series are worth considering.
